title: Release Notes
markdown:
For AI agents: the docs index is at https://developers.hover.to/llms.txt. Append .md to any documentation page URL to get its markdown version.

## v2.0.0   [Skip link to v2.0.0](https://developers.hover.to/docs/release-notes\#v200)

Release Date: October, 2026

### Multi-structure support   [Skip link to Multi-structure support](https://developers.hover.to/docs/release-notes\#multi-structure-support)

- A single Hover job can now hold several structures (models), such as a house plus a detached garage. Each structure gets its own deliverable, reconstruction state, measurements, and estimates in Salesforce.
- New custom object: **Hover Models** (`Hover_Model__c`), related to the parent Hover Job. Each record stores the structure's name, Hover Model ID (`Hover_Model_ID__c`), reconstruction state (`State__c`), deliverable (`Deliverable__c`), and failure reason (`Failure_Reason__c`).
- Hover Model records are created and updated automatically from the `model-created` and `model-state-changed` webhook events. Each structure's name, state, and deliverable are synced from Hover.
- Added a dynamic related list of Hover Models to the Hover Job record page.
- Added a new Hover Model record page and tab. The record page is the default for Hover Model.

### Measurements per structure   [Skip link to Measurements per structure](https://developers.hover.to/docs/release-notes\#measurements-per-structure)

- When a structure finishes reconstructing, its roof and siding measurements are written to that structure's Hover Model record. Each structure's measurements are kept separate, so a garage's measurements never overwrite the house's.
- New `hoverModelMeasurements` LWC shows roof and siding measurements for a single structure on the Hover Model record page.
- The `hoverPDFLink` LWC now works on Hover Model records and opens that structure's measurements PDF. The button turns on once the structure has finished reconstructing and shows a tooltip explaining why while it's disabled.
- The legacy roof and siding measurement fields on the Hover Job object are still present but are no longer updated. Point any reports, flows, or page layouts that use them at Hover Model instead.

### Estimates linked to structures   [Skip link to Estimates linked to structures](https://developers.hover.to/docs/release-notes\#estimates-linked-to-structures)

- Hover Estimates (`Hover_Material_List__c`), Hover Estimate Line Items (`Hover_Estimate_Line_Item__c`), and Adjustments (`Hover_Adjustment__c`) now include a Hover Model lookup (`Hover_Model__c`) alongside the Hover Job lookup, so you can report on estimates by structure.

### Project schedule, deposits, and installments   [Skip link to Project schedule, deposits, and installments](https://developers.hover.to/docs/release-notes\#project-schedule-deposits-and-installments)

New fields on the Hover Estimate object:

- Project schedule: Estimated Start Date (`Estimated_Start_Date__c`), Estimated End Date (`Estimated_End_Date__c`), Actual Start Date (`Actual_Start_Date__c`), and Actual End Date (`Actual_End_Date__c`).
- Deposit: Deposit Amount (`Deposit_Amount__c`), Deposit Due Date (`Deposit_Due_Date__c`), and Deposit Received Date (`Deposit_Received_Date__c`).
- Installments: Installment Count (`Installment_Count__c`) and the full installment schedule in Payment Installments JSON (`Payment_Installments_JSON__c`).
- New `hoverPaymentInstallments` LWC shows the installment schedule on the Hover Estimate record page.

### Prorate deposit by trade   [Skip link to Prorate deposit by trade](https://developers.hover.to/docs/release-notes\#prorate-deposit-by-trade)

- The deposit can now be split across each trade estimate. This is gated behind the new **Prorate Deposit By Trade** custom setting (`Hover_Config__c.Prorate_Deposit_By_Trade__c`), off by default.

### Line item notes   [Skip link to Line item notes](https://developers.hover.to/docs/release-notes\#line-item-notes)

- New field: Notes (`Notes__c`) on the Hover Estimate Line Item object, populated from notes entered in Hover.
- The `materialList` LWC now shows line item notes.

### Multi-structure test jobs   [Skip link to Multi-structure test jobs](https://developers.hover.to/docs/release-notes\#multi-structure-test-jobs)

- New **Create Test Job** list view button on the Hover Jobs tab creates a Hover test job with three structures and links it to a new Hover Job record in Salesforce. **This process takes approximately 1-2 minutes for data to flow back to Salesforce.**

![](https://files.readme.io/0c83a0cb62e927f978fd26174baa0b967dec4b875d7695395e5d6c8fe861c104-image.png)

- Test jobs can only be created from the parent (authenticated) Hover org, not from a suborg.
- The `updateJobStatusButton` LWC now carries a warning that it's for integration testing only. It sets the test state on the whole job, so it doesn't support multi-structure jobs.
- The `updateJobStatusButton` LWC is now hidden on the Hover Job record page once the job's reconstruction state is `completed`.

### Jobs created in Hover link back to Salesforce   [Skip link to Jobs created in Hover link back to Salesforce](https://developers.hover.to/docs/release-notes\#jobs-created-in-hover-link-back-to-salesforce)

- When a job created in Hover is linked to a Salesforce record, the Salesforce record Id is written back to the Hover job's external identifier. Later webhooks for that job then match the right Hover Job record.

### Other changes   [Skip link to Other changes](https://developers.hover.to/docs/release-notes\#other-changes)

- Inspection data is now pulled in when an inspection reaches `complete`. Previously it was pulled at `submitted`.
- Added **Interior Floor Plan** to the Hover Job deliverable picklist (`deliverable_id__c`).
- Job and model data now come from Hover's v3 API.
- Renamed labels on the Hover Job object: **State** is now **Reconstruction State** (`State__c`), and **HOVER Job ID** is now **Hover Job ID** (`HOVER_Job_ID__c`). No API name changes; only the user-visible labels have changed.

### Removed   [Skip link to Removed](https://developers.hover.to/docs/release-notes\#removed)

- The `HOVER_Job_Complete__e` platform event and the `ProcessJobComplete` trigger have been removed. Any flow, trigger, or external subscriber listening for this event will stop receiving it. Use Hover Model state changes instead.
- A job-level "complete" status no longer triggers a measurements fetch. Measurements are now fetched per structure, once that structure is complete.

* * *

## v1.7.16   [Skip link to v1.7.16](https://developers.hover.to/docs/release-notes\#v1716)

Release Date: August 4th, 2026

**Backup User fallback for job creation**

- Jobs that fail to send to Hover with a 422 because the assigned Salesforce user has no Hover account are now automatically retried using a configured backup user, so the job still gets created (under the parent org).
- Set the fallback via the new Backup User Email (Backup\_User\_Email\_\_c) field on the Hover Config custom setting; leave it blank to disable the retry.
- The assignee on the Salesforce Hover Job is left unchanged — existing assignment automations continue to drive reassignment to the intended rep.

**Sync visibility on the Hover Job**

- Two new fields report the outcome of each push to Hover:

Sync Status `Sync_Status__c`) — Synced, Push Failed, Assignment Failed, or Backfilled.

Last Sync Error `Last_Sync_Error__c`) — the status code and response body from Hover when a push fails.

**Safer job reassignment**

- Changing a Hover Job's assignee to a user without a Hover account no longer sends an invalid request.

The integration skips the reassignment call and records the miss on the record `Sync_Status__c` = `Assignment Failed`, with detail in `Last_Sync_Error__c`).
- Reassignment failures returned by Hover are likewise stamped on the Hover Job instead of being logged out of view.

* * *

## v1.7.14   [Skip link to v1.7.14](https://developers.hover.to/docs/release-notes\#v1714)

**Release Date**: July 27th, 2026

**Markup % and Profit Margin on split-by-trade estimates**

- Markup Percent `Markup_Percent__c`) and Profit Margin `Profit_Margin__c`) now populate on each [split-by-trade estimate (a custom setting)](https://developers.hover.to/docs/custom-settings). Previously they appeared only on the combined estimate and were blank on the individual trade estimates.
- Each trade estimate calculates these from its own line items, so every trade shows values specific to that trade.
  - Markup Percent = the trade's total markup ÷ the trade's cost.
  - Profit Margin = (the trade's price after adjustments − the trade's cost) ÷ the trade's price after adjustments.

**Template-level adjustments on split-by-trade estimates**

- Adjustments applied to a single template now carry through to that template's trade estimate, instead of appearing only on the combined estimate.
  - A template-level adjustment now creates a matching record on the Adjustments object `Hover_Adjustment__c`) for that template's trade estimate, in addition to the record on the combined estimate.
  - Whole-job adjustments continue to divide evenly across the trades, and each trade's total still reconciles to the combined estimate.

* * *

## v1.7.13   [Skip link to v1.7.13](https://developers.hover.to/docs/release-notes\#v1713)

**Release Date**: July 23rd, 2026

**Sales tax on split-by-trade estimates**

- Sales tax on [split-by-trade estimates (a custom setting)](https://developers.hover.to/docs/custom-settings) came out too low. It now matches the sales tax in Hover.

  - Each trade estimate shows its own share of the sales tax, and the trades add up to the estimate total.
  - Trade estimates now show the correct **Markup Total**, which previously displayed as zero.

**Discounts and surcharges on split-by-trade estimates**

- Discounts and surcharges now carry through to split-by-trade estimates, so each trade reflects its share.
  - The total adjustment is divided evenly across the trades on the estimate.
  - Each trade's total price now reflects its share of any discount or surcharge.
  - The **Promotions** field is now labeled **Adjustments** (`Promotions__c`). It shows the combined net of every discount and surcharge on an estimate—when a surcharge is larger than the discounts, the value is negative.

**Tax Rate and Waste Factor on estimate line items**

- **Tax Rate** (`Line_Item_Tax_Rate__c`) and **Waste Factor** (`Line_Item_Waste_Factor__c`) now display as decimal numbers instead of percentages, so you can use them directly in reports and formulas.

* * *

## v1.7.12   [Skip link to v1.7.12 ](https://developers.hover.to/docs/release-notes\#v1712-)

**Release Date**: July 14th, 2026

**Mobile Capture Link support**

- The "Open Photo Capture" deep link now uses an HTTPS smart link (`https://hover.app.link?action=capture&identifier=…`) instead of the `hihover://` custom URL scheme.

  - This resolves cases where the link failed to launch the Hover app from within the Salesforce mobile app. On mobile it opens the Hover app directly to the job's Photo Capture flow; on desktop it falls back to the Hover homepage.
  - New field **Mobile Capture Link** (`Mobile_Capture_Link__c`) on the Hover Job record provides this link as clickable text, derived automatically from the Hover Job ID.
  - The **hoverDeepLink** Lightning Web Component now generates the same HTTPS link, so the on-record button works in the Salesforce mobile app.

**Link to Estimate fixed on Hover Job Object**

- The dynamic Estimates related list on the Hover Job record now includes the estimate **Name** and **Hover Material List ID** columns, making it easier to open the associated estimate directly from the job.

* * *

# v1.7.10   [Skip link to v1.7.10 ](https://developers.hover.to/docs/release-notes\#v1710-)

**Release date:** July 9th, 2026

#### **Sub-org webhook support**   [Skip link to [object Object]](https://developers.hover.to/docs/release-notes\#sub-org-webhook-support)

- Jobs created in a Hover sub-org can now be shared to the parent org on creation, so the parent org's webhook subscription receives their completion and measurement events — fixing cases where sub-org jobs never completed or pulled measurements in Salesforce.
- Controlled by the `Enable Suborg Access on Job Create` setting `Hover_Config__c.Enable_Suborg_Access__c`)
- New field: `Parent_Org_ID__c` on the `Hover Job` record, stamped automatically at creation.

* * *

# v1.7.9   [Skip link to v1.7.9](https://developers.hover.to/docs/release-notes\#v179)

**Release date:** June 26th, 2026

#### **Deep link to the Hover mobile app**   [Skip link to [object Object]](https://developers.hover.to/docs/release-notes\#deep-link-to-the-hover-mobile-app)

- New `hoverDeepLink` LWC launches the Photo Capture flow from a record. Placeable on any object via App Builder using the configurable Job ID Field property (default `HOVER_Job_ID__c`, supports lookup paths like `Hover_Job__r.HOVER_Job_ID__c`).
- Companion `Hover_Deep_Link__c` formula field gives the same link as clickable text. Mobile only.

#### Auto-create estimates   [Skip link to [object Object],Auto-create estimates](https://developers.hover.to/docs/release-notes\#auto-create-estimates)

- Estimates are now created in Salesforce upon their creation in Salesforce. This functionality is gated behind the the `Auto Create Estimate` custom setting `Hover_Config__c.Auto_Create_Estimate__c`), off by default.
- **Upgrade note:** grant the guest site user and the Hover permission set access to the new `HoverSyncMaterialListOnCreate` Apex class, or the flow fails silently.


#### **Create Estimates by Trade/Template**   [Skip link to [object Object]](https://developers.hover.to/docs/release-notes\#create-estimates-by-tradetemplate)

- Estimates split by trade/template via `Split_Estimates_By_Trade__c` Custom Setting. This is **off** by default.

#### New Fields Added   [Skip link to New Fields Added](https://developers.hover.to/docs/release-notes\#new-fields-added)

- `Financing_Provider__c`, `Financing_Name__c`, `Financing_APR__c`, `Financing_Length__c`, `Financing_Down_Payment__c,``Is_Financed__c.`all added as new fields to the Hover Estimate object.
- **Adjustments**: promotions now modeled as `Adjustment_Value__c`.
- **New measurement fields**: `Hips_Length__c` and `Ridges_Length__c`

* * *

## v1.7.1   [Skip link to v1.7.1](https://developers.hover.to/docs/release-notes\#v171)

**Release date:** March 4th, 2026

**Job Notes**

- Added `Hover_Note__c` and `Hover_Note_ID__c` fields to the Hover Job object to

support creating and updating notes directly from Salesforce.
- Notes are automatically posted to Hover when a job is created with a note

pre-filled, and patched when the field is updated on an existing job.

**Deliverable Change Request**

- Added support for the `deliverable-change-request-state-changed` webhook

event, enabling the integration to process upgrades from Capture Only jobs to

Roof Only or Complete.
- On completion, the job's deliverable type is updated in Salesforce and

measurements are automatically retrieved.

**Capture Only, Photos Only**

- Added support for Deliverable ID 7 (Capture Only, Photos Only) when creating

HOVER jobs from Salesforce.

**Deliverable Sync on Job Completion**

- When a Hover job reaches the complete state, the `Deliverable_ID__c` field on

the Salesforce record is now automatically updated to reflect the deliverable

type in Hover (Roof Only or Complete).

**Hover Estimate Line Items**

- Introduced a new `Hover_Estimate_Line_Item__c` custom object to store

individual line items from Hover estimates, with fields for name, product ID,

quantity, unit cost, total price, markup, tax rate, waste factor, trade type,

activity code, measurement unit, and variation.

- Added full CRUD support (create, update, delete, upsert) for Estimate Line

Items, synced from the Hover Estimate API response.


**Estimate Locking**

- Added a new estimate\_is\_locked\_\_c field to the Hover Estimate custom object

to track lock status.
- `Implemented HoverLockEstimate` and `HoverQueueableLockEstimate` Apex classes to

call the HOVER API and lock an estimate.
- Added a new Lock Hover Estimate Flow to trigger the locking process from the

UI.
- Updated the Update Hover Job Flow to incorporate the new estimate lock

process flow.

## v1.6.3   [Skip link to v1.6.3](https://developers.hover.to/docs/release-notes\#v163)

**Release date:** January 26, 2026

- **Estimation integration (Hover → Salesforce)**
  - Added a new custom object: `Hover Estimates`
  - Supports a **one-way sync** of estimation data from Hover into Salesforce
  - Users can initiate the Estimation workflow from Salesforce via an **LWC** on the **Hover Job** object
- **Inspection integration (Hover → Salesforce)**
  - Added a new custom object: `Hover Inspections`
  - Supports a **one-way sync** of inspection data from Hover into Salesforce
- **Related lists**
  - Added **dynamic related lists** for **Inspections** and **Estimates** on the parent **Hover Job** object
- **Renaming**
  - Renamed **Hover Material Lists** to **Hover Estimates**
  - **No API name changes**: underlying API names remain the same; only the **user-visible labels** have changed
